Work from AnyWhere (WAW) Portal
SMART PDS
User Manual- New Ration Card Registration

Purpose of the Manual 
The Purpose Of This User Manual Is To Guide Citizens In Navigating And Completing 
The New Ration Card Form Within The Smart PDS System. It Provides Step-by-step 
Instructions To Ensure A Smooth And Efficient Registration Process, Helping Users 
Understand Each Section Of The Form, Required Information, And Submission 
Procedures. By Following This Manual, Citizens Will Be Able To Successfully Register 
their New Ration card With Minimal Confusion Or Errors, Enhancing Their Overall 
Experience With The Smart PDS Platform.

Citizen have an option to choose a Nominee-In situations where the Head of the Family (HOF) is unable to collect 
ration(due to old age, disability, or other). A nominee may be designated to collect the ration on their behalf. The nominee 
must not be a member listed on the same ration card and can be a trusted individual such as a neighbor or another 
known person.
